sections.label: vmin
sections.description: Value drawn at the low end of the colormap; lower values are clipped to it.

sections.label: vmax
sections.description: Value drawn at the high end of the colormap; higher values are clipped to it.

buttons.label: Auto contrast
buttons.description: Reset vmin/vmax from the image: symmetric around zero (99th percentile of |value|) for residuals, the full range otherwise.

sections.label: x min
sections.description: Left edge of the shown x range, in axis units.

sections.label: x max
sections.description: Right edge of the shown x range, in axis units.

sections.label: y min
sections.description: Bottom edge of the shown y range, in axis units.

sections.label: y max
sections.description: Top edge of the shown y range, in axis units.

sections.label: Colormap
sections.description: Colour scale of the image; a diverging map (RdBu, bwr) shows the sign of a residual.

sections.label: Image source
sections.description: Which image the model provides is shown: residuals, data, model, intensity, ...

sections.label: Frame index
sections.description: Frame of the image stack shown (for a correlation carpet: the frame lag).
